abrogate: Ab + rogare: ask away. Abrogate a treaty.
bastardization: Bastard: impure. A bastardization of the recipe.
canard: Canard: duck; hoax. Spread a canard.
capitulate: Capitulum: chapter heading; terms. Capitulate at dawn.
cataclysm: Kata + kluzein: wash down. A cataclysm struck.
concomitant: Con + comitari: go along. Concomitant risks.
dissemble: Dis + simulare: hide. Dissemble his anger.
dissolution: Dis + solvere: loosen. Dissolution of parliament.
ebullient: E + bullire: boil. An ebullient greeting.
enamored: En + amor. Enamored of her voice.
eponym: Epi + onyma: name upon. Newton is an eponym.
exorbitant: Ex + orbita: out of the track. Exorbitant fees.
hoodwink: Hood over eyes. Hoodwinked by a con.
ineluctable: In + eluctari: can’t struggle out. Ineluctable fate.
modicum: Modus: measure. A modicum of respect.
obtain: Ob + tenere: hold. The rules that obtain.
panacea: Pan + akos: all cure. No panacea exists.
pillory: Pillory: wooden stocks. Pilloried in the press.
row: Row rhymes cow. A family row.
sardonic: Sardinian plant: grin. A sardonic smile.
simulacrum: Simulare: imitate. A simulacrum of democracy.
splenetic: Spleen: temper organ. A splenetic outburst.
surfeit: Sur + faire: overdo. A surfeit of cake.
verisimilitude: Verus + similis: truth-like. Verisimilitude in fiction.
